title: From Unit Interval Orders to Totally Nonnegative Matrices: Permanental Inequalities and Bruhat-Increasing Bijections
summary: Given an $n\times n$ matrix $A=(a_{i,j})$ and subsets $I,J$ of $[1,n]:=\{1,\dotsc,n\}$, let $A_{I,J}=(a_{i,j})_{i\in I,j\in J}$ denote the $(I,J)$-submatrix of $A$.
